name: usb-host-probe
description: A one-shot test of the USB host mode through a USB-C mod (USB-AUDIO-OUT.md, Stage 0). Select "Start the probe at the next restart", eject and restart the iPod, then press a button. The iPod first plays each sign tone one time (long low, then high, low, high), then three short beeps and a silence. Then it starts its USB host stack one time, and the real signs follow. A long low tone: the host stack runs (a second one: the hub in the adapter). High, low, high: a USB flash drive or card reader was found. The iPod does not react for approximately 7 seconds during the tones. The next restart is normal again. CAUTION: While the probe runs, the USB port possibly does not operate with a computer. Restart the iPod (hold Menu and Select) to stop the probe.
